items.root_cause: The category-exclude library (grocery/category-excludes.json, read by the bake, the audit-food-category guard and the vet sheet) had no class for a frozen or heat-and-eat ENTREE, no token for the named snack, dairy and bakery products that won these cells, no rule that a roast or whole subprimal is not a steak, and it scopes by display category: jarred-gravy and sun-dried-tomatoes sit in 'Canned & Soup' beside real soups and chili, so no category block could carry an entree or snack class to them (the class-scope-by-display-taxonomy shape). Each commodity's own fences named product WORDS ('cracker', 'yog', 'frozen') that these names never contain, and jarred-gravy's '&' fence was a dead regex. A wrong prepared product is usually cheaper per unit than the raw food, so it takes the crown; and because the guard reads the same library, it read OK over every one.

items.root_cause: A prepared product is named by its flavour, and a flavour is usually a PAIR of ingredient words. A raw-ingredient commodity includes its bare word, so first-match-wins handed the product to whichever ingredient sat earliest in commodities.json, and each per-product fence (apples fences rice crisps, peaches fences florida's natural, jalapenos fences hummus, strawberries fences fruit rolls) only moved it to the NEXT ingredient word in its name. The carried pass made the moves visible for the first time; they had been sitting in the baseline under old routes.

root_fix.what: category-excludes.json gains the flavour_pair_carrier class: two flavour words side by side joined by a space, and, & or + (never 'or': an either-or ad line is two products at one price), with honey and tangerine deliberately not flavour words (Honey Mangos, Honey Tangerines are produce) and a lookahead for orange habanero/bell/peppers (a colour). Scoped to all 116 Fruit and Vegetables commodities (first apply block) and by apply_ids to 37 single-ingredient spices, the three plain sugars and feta; baked by apply-category-excludes.ps1 and written back as minimal insertions (157 commodities, appended excludes only). audit-food-category (the blocking guard) reads the same library, so a flavour-pair product on a scoped cell now hard-fails the publish. items.root_cause: build-sams-deals derives a Sam's size from linePrice/unitPrice and returned 'no unitPrice' for every blank unit price. Sam's leaves unitPrice blank on some reads of items it prices with a unit price on other days, so 51-65% of the blank rows were products whose size this builder had already proved from Sam's own arithmetic, and each re-read was thrown away: the board kept the last proved read (hummus as_of 09-22) until the 14-day window dropped it, and a moved price never reached it (Hillshire Farm Turkey Polska Kielbasa 14 oz: board $7.57 as_of 09-19, Sam's shelf $9.57 on 09-26).

root_fix.what: Get-SamsProofIndex / Get-SamsCarriedRow. A BLANK unit price (an unreadable non-blank one is still refused, case 8j) looks up the newest proof for the same sams_item_id + exact name in the builder's own out dir (-OutDir, else out\sams), dated before the capture and inside the quarter (capture-policy-lib Get-PolicyQuarterDays, dot-sourced in function scope). Only a package-shape proof whose qty_basis starts 'package; qty name' carries (never a derived lp/up size); proofs that disagree on the size carry nothing; the proof is re-run through Build-Row under today's rules and must return the same size. The row is today's linePrice over the proved size, marked imputed: qty_basis 'package; qty carried: <basis> on <date> at <lp>; Sam's printed no unit price today', size_proven_on, sams_unit_price_proven, and sams_unit_price blank (so compare-deals' native unit price and audit-basis-reconcile never read the proof day's arithmetic as today's). A row with no proof keeps the plain 'no unitPrice'.
root_fix.held_out_error_estimate: Hide-and-score (data-quality-craft imputation rule): over 10 build days 2026-09-12..26, every row that DID print a unit price with a name-proved size and an earlier proof: 4,643 cases, 4,601 identical size, 26 refused as disagreeing proofs, 16 different size strings, 15 of those the same quantity in another spelling (e.g. 112 oz vs 64 ct 1.75 oz, 128 fl oz vs gal) and 1 a magnitude difference (Krusteaz Gluten Free Cornbread 15 oz., 3 pk.: carry 45 oz = the name's 3 x 15, that day's arithmetic 15 oz = one piece). items.root_cause: Three separate gaps in where a check looks. (1) The quarantine protocol had no way for a child to say 'every finding is proven off the board', so a row no cell carries could only be board scoped. (2) The flag verifier needs sanity-check's flags, which exist only after publish, so the ledger guards reads is always judged one chain earlier, by the verifier code of that time. (3) Category coverage is a property of two tracked source files but was checked only at data time (chain and publish), never at push time.

Fail closed where evidence is missing: no board, an unreadable board, or a violated row with no name affirms no scope and the board holds. items.root_cause: the soundness baseline had two roads to 'reviewed' for a contested name, the per-name lane ledger and the whole-state -Accept, and the accept road carried no per-name reading, so any accept for any reason blessed every undecided arrival of its day

The alert body, the report pointer and publish-deals-page's HELD line now name resolve-match-worklist.ps1 -Decide as the road for a contested product.

items.premise_verified: TRUE, and both of the finding's questions are answered. (1) ops/rehearse-chain.ps1 at main c6783fa8e ages data with Get-RhNewestBoardDate, the date in the newest comparison-*.json FILE NAME, at 4 sites (lines ~541, ~755, ~941-944, ~1092), against $script:RhMaxDataAgeDays = 2. On disk 2026-09-26: comparison-2026-09-23.json carries built_at 2026-09-26T08:06:07. (2) The name is not stuck: compare-deals.ps1 line 2449 sets $today = $ads.today and names the board and week_of from the newest out/ads-<D>.json, which is written only on a day a weekly ad is pulled. So the name is the AD SET and does not advance between ad days by design; the defect is the rehearsal (and other consumers) reading it as 'now'. Recorded by the sibling in memory the-board-has-three-dates.
items.root_cause: one variable (week_of, the board's file-name date) answered two questions, 'which ad set' and 'how old is the data', and it lags the real date by the days since the last weekly ad pull (3 days on 2026-09-26), so the F2 two-day bar refused every chain push from day 3 of any stretch with no ad due.

root_fix.what: held on the sibling branch claude/board-clock, design/PLAN-board-clock-2026-09-26.md (approved by Brad 2026-09-26, D1-D3): Get-RhNewestBoardDate becomes Get-RhBoardDataDate, which uses the name only to PICK the newest board and reads the data age from the newest price READ on it (as_of, lib/board-clock.ps1). Never built_at, which a rebuild over old captures would launder fresh (dates-written-not-measured). All four data-age sites read it; a board with no dated price is blind, never fresh by its name.
